title: Adult with acute low back pain
goal: You are the clinician. Assess a patient with acute low back pain: cover onset, quality, neurologic symptoms, and red flags.
opening: I hurt my back lifting boxes yesterday and now I can barely stand up straight.

disclosures.response: Yesterday afternoon I was lifting moving boxes and felt something pop in my lower back.
It is in my lower back. It is a sharp pain when I twist or bend.
The pain shoots down the back of my right thigh, and my foot tingles sometimes.
My bladder and bowels are fine, and I have no numbness around my groin — just the tingling in my foot.
I have tried ibuprofen and a heating pad. It takes the edge off but the shooting pain keeps coming back.
I had a flare-up like this two years ago that settled with physical therapy. I take no regular medications.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.rationale: Introduces self and establishes permission or rapport.
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself and ask permission before proceeding.

metrics.name: Symptom characterization
metrics.rationale: Explores onset, location, quality, and aggravating factors of the pain.
metrics.coaching_hint: Characterize the pain: 'Where is it, and what were you doing when it started?'

metrics.name: Neurologic symptoms
metrics.rationale: Checks for radicular pain, paresthesias, or weakness suggesting nerve involvement.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about neurologic symptoms: 'Does the pain travel down your leg, with any numbness, tingling, or weakness?'

metrics.name: Red-flag screening
metrics.rationale: Screens for cauda equina red flags: bladder/bowel changes and saddle anesthesia.
metrics.coaching_hint: Screen red flags: 'Any changes in bladder or bowel control, or numbness around your groin?'

metrics.name: History and prior episodes
metrics.rationale: Explores prior episodes, medications, and relevant history.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about history: 'Have you had back problems before, and do you take any medications?'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Checks understanding and confirms the immediate next step.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm the plan and check understanding before ending.
